title: OpenAI Playground Assistant is POWERFUL! Here's how to BUILD one...

comments.author: @NPCforsale
comments.text:
I made a Custom GPT this morning to review and create YouTube ads. I scraped ~50 of the top YouTube ads I could find, analyzed them all (used Harpa for that part), and then fed them into the Custom GPT, along with a client ad that wasn't performing very well.

I adjusted the ad, based on the AI's recommendations and threw it into a split test...

Control version's still at 10% making to the end of the ad
AI version is at 73% making it to the end of the ad with a much higher CTR

Pretty. Darn. Cool.
